title: Designer
summary: Gives the organization's materials a clear, consistent and accessible look: design systems and brand guides, presentations and documents built from them, consistency audits, and accessibility checks on everything it delivers.
_gcp_roles_comment: None beyond the generic base set. Slides, Docs and Drive are reached as the agent's own Google Workspace account through domain-wide delegation, which needs no Google Cloud role on the project.
_setup_comment: No packages beyond the generic role's: rendering uses LibreOffice and Chromium, pixel sampling ImageMagick, PDF checks poppler-utils, all in the generic toolchain; contrast-check is a Node command.
